During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Jedi Consular]] later known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] owned a '''[[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]]'''.
